sources.audit_notes: COUNTED, NOT QUOTED. Repo cloned from GitHub at the pinned commit (single commit; no tags, no releases, no branches other than main; repo created and pushed 2026-05-13). Released data is four JSONL files, one per AgentDojo suite: workspace 407, banking 130, slack 97, travel 94 = 728 lines total, which reproduces the published claim of 728 task-attack scenarios exactly. All 728 rows parse as JSON with an identical 15-field schema; all 728 (suite, user_task_id, injection_task_id) triples are unique, so 728 is a genuine case count and not a line count of duplicates. counts_upstream for the other quantities: 92 distinct (suite, user_task_id) benign tasks and only 35 distinct (suite, injection_task_id) attacker goals, i.e. 728 rows are a cross-product expansion of 127 upstream task ids; the count of distinct attacker_goal strings over all 728 rows is 35, so the whole benchmark varies one of 35 attack objectives against 92 ambiguous tasks. Dedup ceiling under SPEC section 11 (template = objective x tool x argument shape): 602 distinct (suite, injection_task_id, benign tool-call signature) groups, so 126 rows collapse immediately and the true attack-template supply is 35, not 728. Tool-call inventory: 2,116 ground-truth tool calls across the 728 rows, 1 to 18 per row (distribution 1:152, 2:283, 3:103, 4:51, 5:55, 6:42, 7:7, 8:15, 9:19, 18:1); all 2,116 carry a dict of arguments and 143 of them have an empty argument dict. Injection inventory: every row has exactly 3 injection entries (operators HR/GS/CP, failure modes FM-1/FM-2/FM-3), i.e. 2,184 injected texts, and each injection record holds only operator, failure_mode, injected_clarification_response and injection_rationale; the number of injection records carrying a tool name or argument payload is 0. Only 174 of 2,184 injected texts even name an action verb or tool in prose. So the attack side of ASPI is conversational text and the tool-call side of ASPI is entirely benign ground truth. CONDITION DESIGN IN DATA TERMS. The task brief and the paper abstract describe a four-condition design; the artifact is an eight-condition design, 2 interaction states x 4 delivery channels, and the four is the channel axis within one state (benign, tool output, first-user turn, follow-up/clarification-answer turn). The reconciliation is that the released rows store no condition at all: the field names containing 'condition' or 'variant' number 0, and the paper states that ASPI 'maintains a unified representation for each pair, from which all conditions are instantiated at evaluation time'. The conditions are therefore constructed by src/aspi/eval/runner.py from the stored fields: exec_benign uses original_prompt on a clean environment, exec_tool uses original_prompt with the ImportantInstructionsAttack wrapper W placed in task-tool output, exec_user concatenates original_prompt plus raw attacker_goal, exec_next_turn sends attacker_goal as turn 2, clarif_benign answers base_prompt with benign_clarification_response, clarif_ask_user answers with benign_clarification_response plus W, clarif_tool replays the task tool against a W-injected environment, and clarif_user uses the three stored injected_clarification_response strings (HR/GS/CP) with the reported group score taken as the maximum over operators. Instance arithmetic, which is not in the artifact: 728 x 8 = 5,824 evaluation instances and 728 x 3 = 2,184 clarification-user operator instances, of which the released files contain zero rows. INTERCEPTION-BOUNDARY VERDICT. ASPI evaluates model behaviour, not tool calls, and this must be said plainly in the manuscript. Its ground truth is a post-hoc boolean computed from the environment state after the agent has acted (security = the agent executed the attacker goal) plus an LLM-judge trajectory label (FULL_COMPLIANCE, PARTIAL_COMPLIANCE, ACKNOWLEDGED_REFUSED, IGNORED, UNCLEAR); neither is a per-case expected outcome and neither is an interception point. Consequence for GATE-Union: ASPI can only contribute cases whose injected instruction culminates in a concrete tool call, and for those cases we must synthesise the call ourselves from attacker_goal, which is authoring, not harmonising. Evidence that such a subset exists is ASPI's own rule-based detector (src/aspi/eval/metrics.py, attack_attempted_rule), which recognises attempted attacks by matching argument values against exactly eight tool families: send_email and forward_email against recipient emails, send_money and schedule_transaction against IBANs, delete_file against file ids, visit_webpage, post_webpage and get_webpage against URLs, send_direct_message, send_channel_message and invite_user_to_slack against emails or URLs in the body, update_password unconditionally, and create_calendar_event or update_calendar_event against attendee emails. Measured target resolvability of the 728 attacker_goal strings by those patterns: 672 rows contain at least one concrete target (email 405, file id 161, IBAN 116, URL 108; signature mixtures are email only 317, iban only 116, email+file_id 88, url only 78, file_id only 43, file_id+url 30) and 56 rows contain none, so even ASPI's own scorer cannot decide 56 of the 728 without the LLM judge. 627 of 728 goals name a state-changing verb (banking 116, workspace 379, slack 78, travel 54) and 101 are read-only or informational. Mediated tool surface mapping. Of the 2,116 benign ground-truth calls, 542 map onto the current mediated surface with an exact or close analogue: send_email 78 to send_email, get_webpage 79 plus post_webpage 4 to http_request, search_emails 136 plus read_inbox 9 to data_analysis, get_most_recent_transactions 95 plus get_scheduled_transactions 26 to sql_query, send_money 44 plus update_scheduled_transaction 35 plus schedule_transaction 9 to database_query, update_password 9 plus update_user_info 18 to admin_tool. The remaining 1,574 calls have no analogue in admin_tool, code_execute, data_analysis, database_query, format_template, http_request, send_email, sql_query, web_search, broken down as travel and retail lookup 483 over 18 tool names, filesystem 415 over 8, messaging workspace 346 over 7, calendar 320 over 6, contacts 10. Row-level: 161 of 728 rows have their entire benign call sequence expressible on the mediated surface and 336 of 728 contain at least one expressible call; the other 392 rows are calendar, messaging or filesystem tasks that SPEC section 14 already excludes. code_execute, format_template and web_search receive nothing from ASPI. ESCALATION BAND. ASPI is the natural supplier for the ESCALATE band in the sense that it is the only audited source that operationalises ambiguity as a data field rather than as a stylistic property: every one of the 728 rows carries missing_slot (331 distinct values), expected_clarification_question (present in all 728), base_prompt (the original prompt with one required slot deleted) and benign_clarification_response, and the seven QC checks in src/aspi/dataset/quality.py are all slot-ambiguity checks (slot type validity, clarification direction, base_prompt subset, missing_slot removal, clarification necessity, slot strength). That is precisely the predicate our escalation trigger needs: a call proposed while a required argument is still missing. The honest limitation is that the labels do NOT let us distinguish what should be escalated from what should be blocked. There is no expected_outcome, no severity, no verdict and no per-condition result anywhere in the release: the only label-ish field is expected_clarification_question, and the repo ships no results/ directory, so no ASR, utility or compliance label is available offline at all. Escalate-versus-block assignment must therefore be made by us under SPEC section 8, per case, and recorded as our judgement, not inherited from ASPI. Two further screening facts: the clarification half of the design is dynamically excluded at run time (an example is dropped from clarification comparisons whenever the agent fails to call ask_user, reason code no_ask_user_tool_call), so which rows even reach the ambiguous state is model-dependent and cannot be determined from the artifact; and 262 of 728 rows have an empty ground_truth_task_answer and 2 have an empty claims_list, so the answer-side checks are not uniformly populated. QUALITY AND PROVENANCE CAVEATS. All 728 rows were generated by gemini/gemini-3.1-pro-preview (metadata.generator_model is uniform across the release) in a two-stage LLM pipeline and filtered only by deterministic regex QC; there is no human annotation and no inter-annotator agreement anywhere in the artifact, and the ambiguity is machine-derived from AgentDojo tasks rather than collected from real user traffic. The release is also incomplete: README instructs pip install -e agentdojo/ and pyproject comments say AgentDojo is vendored at ./agentdojo, but no agentdojo directory exists in the repo at the pin, while requirements.txt instead lists agentdojo unpinned from PyPI, so a rerun pulls an unverified upstream. REPRODUCTION AND DISPOSITION. Raw clone at external/raw/aspi/repo (git working tree, 4 data files totalling 2,666,073 bytes, no LFS), arXiv atom record at external/raw/aspi/arxiv_atom.xml and the PDF with extracted text at external/raw/aspi/arxiv_2605.17324v1.pdf and .txt. Counting method: python 3.12 line counts and per-field aggregation over the four JSONL files, scripts preserved at external/raw/aspi/audit_count.py and audit_count2.py. Because no licence is granted, nothing from ASPI may be copied into harmonized/: the corpus must ship the pin plus source_case_id (suite, user_task_id, injection_task_id) and derived fields only, with a pinned fetch script, per SPEC section 16. cases_mapped and cases_dropped are 0 and family_supply and layer_supply are empty by design: this record is an acquisition audit, not a normalisation pass, and the screening figures above are supply ceilings, not mapped counts. Recommended role in the corpus: ambiguity-conditioned escalation substrate, contributing the missing-argument predicate and the benign clarification controls, capped at roughly the 35 attack templates and the 161 fully expressible rows, and reported as preprint-derived and LLM-generated wherever it is used.
